correctness.rationale: The homogeneous difference recurrence on a circular word has a three-periodic nonzero solution or is zero; hence a nonzero difference exists exactly for 3|n. Fixing the kernel difference with zeros in residue r, both admissible sources force the unflipped bits to zero and the flipped neighbors to be unequal, independently giving blocks (0,b_j,1 XOR b_j). Their output is one outside residue r and 1 XOR b_(j-1) XOR b_j in residue r. This cyclic difference map has constants as its two-element kernel and image the even-parity words, giving exactly the claimed Y_r and two preimages per r. Two different r require every output site to be one. The all-one output has the three periodic single-one sources; the other element in its full linear coset is the inadmissible all-one source. Every other multiple fiber has exactly one kernel-difference type and thus size two. Trace of the nth power of the two-state adjacency matrix gives L_n. Summing 2A_2+3A_3 and subtracting from L_n gives A_1; summing all positive fibers proves the image/codebook count. This includes n=3 (one singleton and one triple, no doubles). The failure probability on admissible sources is (3·2^m-3)/L_(3m) on multiples of three and zero otherwise. Independent enumeration through n=18 corroborated these counts and every Y_r, including the pair counts by difference. The comparison to the Fibonacci-cube XOR record in the prior-work prose should distinguish path from cycle, but that does not affect the claim or proof.
residual_risks: The finite check does not replace the all-length kernel and parity argument. No claim for later iterates or rotation quotients is certified.
